facts.text: Serve the mains when Rod calls Jerry from the kitchen in Arizona.
facts.why: Rod's long phone call ends with 'Show me the money!' but no source I read says where Rod is when he calls. The kitchen is not confirmed.
facts.fix: Serve the mains when Rod makes Jerry shout 'Show me the money.'

facts.text: I wrote the memo at three in the morning on a lot of coffee. It cost me my job, but I kept the goldfish and the takeaway menus.
facts.why: Jerry calls it 'a mission statement. Not a memo' in his voiceover, and a trivia page has him writing it at 2 a.m. I found no source for three in the morning, coffee or takeaway menus. The goldfish is real.
facts.fix: I wrote it overnight. Not a memo, a mission statement. It cost me my job, but I kept the goldfish.
